case_name: Poster or flyer with exact details
title: Long Venue Address Preserved Exactly
tests: Checks that a long address survives rendering without abbreviation, dropped components, altered punctuation or illegibly small type.

exact_text.text: Unit 14B, Second Floor, The Old Foundry Arts Centre, 127–129 St. John's Road, Kingston upon Thames, KT1 2AB
exact_text.read_as:
Unit 14B, Second
Floor, [garbled text] Arts Centre,
127–129 St. John’s Road
Kingston upon Thames, KT1 2AB

faults.what: The address line containing “Floor, The Old Foundry Arts Centre,” is visibly corrupted, with overlapping or broken lettering that makes the venue name unreadable.
The required comma after “Road” is missing, and the apostrophe in “John's” has been changed to a curly apostrophe, violating the letter-for-letter address requirement.
The headline uses a curly apostrophe rather than the requested straight apostrophe.

judge.summary: The flyer has a clean portrait layout and correct date and time, but its garbled address and altered punctuation make it unsuitable for use.

must_haves.item: The headline reads exactly "Printmakers' Open Studio".
must_haves.why: The words are correct, but the apostrophe is curly rather than straight.

must_haves.item: The date and time read exactly '9 October 2027' and '11:00–17:00'.
must_haves.why: Both are clearly readable and correct.

must_haves.item: The entire address appears in order: "Unit 14B, Second Floor, The Old Foundry Arts Centre, 127–129 St. John's Road, Kingston upon Thames, KT1 2AB"; line breaks are permitted.
must_haves.why: The middle of the address is garbled and cannot be read as the complete required venue name; the comma after Road is also absent.

must_haves.item: The address preserves the en dash in '127–129', the period and apostrophe in "St. John's", and every comma.
must_haves.why: The range dash and period are visible, but the apostrophe is changed and the comma after Road is missing.

must_haves.item: All address text is comfortably legible and inside the canvas, with no truncation or abbreviations.
must_haves.why: The address is inside the canvas, but its second line is badly corrupted and not comfortably legible.

must_haves.item: The single portrait 4:5 flyer uses black and cream and contains no extra wording.
must_haves.why: It is a single 4:5 portrait flyer with black text on a pale cream/off-white background and no apparent extra wording.
